title: paspalum laeviglume
intro: Paspalum laeviglume, commonly known as smooth paspalum, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Paspalum laeviglume include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
